title: Dynamic fluctuations of emotional states in adolescents with delayed sleep phase—a longitudinal network modeling approach
limitations: - DSP was based on only one diagnostic criterion; - DSP was assessed only once; - Limited scalability due to EMA intensity; - Potential selection bias due to dropouts; - No adjustment for residual confounding despite no SES differences
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The study was registered under Clinical Trials (ID: 1287174), but no pre-registration for the network analysis methods is mentioned. Data availability is not declared in the paper.
